services.desc: Whether you slip away for a few hours or set sail on a full-day adventure, a Pocono river trip promises an unforgettable experience along the Delaware, where you can witness some of the area’s exotic wildlife, including birds of prey, or simply lay back and enjoy the ride. Available May through October. Explore the Delaware River with one of our experienced guides. Depart on a 3-mile journey from Smithfield Beach Paddle the serene Delaware River in a large, stable inflatable raft. Rafts are perfect for those seeking a communal experience.
